digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter and capability system
propositions: Post-run Epic-field contract validation in jira_dc_capability_map.py must refuse to vouch for reports it cannot verify and exit non-zero with verdict recorded in run_metadata.json

Capability call sites lack runtime guards and fail silently when transport is non-capable, requiring isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback guards and distinct skip-vs-failure reporting on bridge_alerts channel
The dormant absence-probe port and its supporting units (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, inbound_probe.py) must be deleted as per operator ruling

Live DC harness was already failing on pre-existing commit c87afedba8 before this epic's three changes landed, so non-regression must be measured as absence of regressions relative to baseline not on absolute greenness
